name: Keybinds Galore
description:
Keybinds Galore enhances Minecraft's keybinding system with a pie menu, priority actions, conflict detection, and more.
v1.7.2 (Fabric 1.21.11):
- Upgraded to Minecraft 1.21.11
- owo-lib-based pie menu rendering (OwoUIDrawContext.drawRing/drawCircle)
- Fabric API 0.141.4+1.21.11, owo-lib 0.13.0+1.21.11
- ModMenu 17.0.0, Full Cloth Config GUI with all options + hover tooltips
- All prior features: pie menu, K-key capture flow, priority system
